correctness.rationale: On Cr_n=K_{n,n}-M the exact neighbor count is s_B-b_i (left) and s_A-a_i (right). For even n=2m the degree is odd and every shore updates to 0,1 or opposite complement according as the other population is below m, above m or equals m. This gives involutions on the balanced subspace, exact P1=2+C_n and two-cycle count (C_n+1)(C_n+2)/2, plus worst entry time 0 (n=2) or 1. For odd n=2m+1, tie-retention gives operations 0,Y&not X,Y|not X,1 on L/U/V/H population classes; six representative class pairs under shore swap and complement exhaust the dynamics and give a single opposing unanimous period-two orbit, explicit fixed/basin counts and sharp T=2 (n=3) or 3 (n>=5). Direct independently coded neighborhood iteration exhaustively checked 4^n labelled states for n=1..7, including exact basin/orbit/transient counts. Infinite n follows from case analysis and binomial enumeration, not the finite exhaustive sample.
residual_risks: The n=1 two-isolates case and n=2,3 small-size thresholds are handled separately; synchronous strict-neighbor majority with retention on ties only.
